plan.title: From Blank to Bowl: The Oak Bowl Story
plan.summary: Opens with the finished oiled oak bowl, then traces its making from rough fallen-tree blank through grain reading, lathe turning, even wall shaping, sanding, and food-safe oil finish to ready-to-use after 24 hours.

segments.label: Finished bowl reveal
segments.reason: Top-down view of finished oiled oak bowl with concentric grain on dark planks. Rests on spoken intro cited in [0.6-3.7] This is the finished oak bowl, oiled and ready for the table; start moved back to sentence start at 0.4 s.

segments.label: Raw oak blank
segments.reason: Close view of rough blank texture and grain rings. Rests on spoken line cited in [8.6-11.4] Here is the raw oak blank, still wet and heavy; start moved back to sentence start at 8.4 s.

segments.label: Lathe shaping
segments.reason: Bowl spinning with tool contact and shavings forming shape. Rests on spoken line cited in [16.7-19.2] On the lathe the shape appears in long, steady cuts; start moved back to sentence start at 16.4 s.

segments.label: Even wall thickness
segments.reason: Continued turning showing rim to base profile being refined. Rests on spoken line cited in [20.5-23.0] I keep the wall thickness even from rim to base; start moved back to sentence start at 20.2 s.

segments.label: Sanding smooth
segments.reason: Sanding stage with lathe turning slowly and surface smoothing. Rests on spoken line cited in [24.7-28.2] Sanding goes from coarse to fine, with the lathe turning slowly; start moved back to sentence start at 24.4 s.

segments.label: Oil finish
segments.reason: Oiled surface with deepened color and glowing grain. Rests on spoken line cited in [32.7-35.3] A coat of food safe oil brings out the color; start moved back to sentence start at 32.4 s.

segments.label: Ready after 24 hours
segments.reason: Final finished bowl at rest after curing. Rests on spoken line cited in [36.5-39.2] 24 hours later, the bowl is ready to use; start moved back to sentence start at 36.0 s.

review.verdict: This 22.7s cut serves the goal: the 0.0-3.3s finished bowl with oiled and ready line opens on payoff, then 3.3-19.5s raw blank, lathe cuts, sanding and oiling shows the making to the 19.5-22.7s ready bowl close.
review.caption_suggestion: Wet oak blank to oiled table bowl in 23 seconds
strengths: 0.0-3.3s finished bowl close-up with oiled and ready for the table line gives instant payoff.
6.4-12.1s spinning bowl with long cuts and even rim-to-base line shows flying shavings and shaping action.
15.9-19.5s deepened grain color on the oiled bowl while hearing food safe oil line makes the finish visible.

fixes.what: Add gentle push-in on 0.0-3.3s finished bowl grain to give life to the static opening while hearing oiled and ready.
Lift caption contrast during 12.1-15.9s sanding passage where the spinning bowl surface looks brightest.
